title: 第7章 重塑灵根第8章 幻音夫人
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第7章重塑灵根五日的见习眨眼结束。
云洛仰躺在合欢树粗壮的树枝上，嘴里叼着一块合欢花糕。
拽拽趴在她肚皮上，两只爪子捧着一株灵草像兔子一样嚼嚼嚼，末了又从云洛腰间的锦袋中掏出一颗灵丹塞进嘴里。
灵草和灵丹是其他峰的师姐送来的。
合欢宗已经有十多年没收过亲传弟子了，云洛自然成了亲传里的小师妹。
都说百姓爱幺儿，放在修仙界居然也不意外。
云洛一不小心成了团宠。
见拽拽吃得两腮鼓鼓，她摸着它胖乎乎的脑袋。
“拽拽，喜欢合欢宗吗？”
拽拽边啃丹药边点头。
它腿伤都好了，能不喜欢吗？
云洛翻身变为侧躺∶“我也喜欢。等我灵根恢复了，我为你寻来更好的灵丹妙药，让你也跟着我修仙。”
按兔狲的寿命，拽拽的生命该到尽头了，可得益于多年喂食的灵草，它如今的寿命至少有三十年。
这就叫一人得道，兔狲升天。
拽拽啃完丹药，胖脑袋蹭了蹭她脸颊，然后倒地，翻身露出柔软的肚子。
云洛伸出邪恶之手rua了两下。
这手感，爽。
打闹片刻，玉简震动，云洛拿起一看，是惊鸿长老让她速去太和峰主殿一趟。
她不敢耽误，忙吹响脖间挂着的骨哨。
迈巴鹤张开巨大的翅膀蹲在树下。

云洛翻身稳稳跳上去，朝树上的拽拽挥手。
“乖乖在家等我。”
拽拽圆润的身子一翻，打了个哈欠，趴在树干上发出呼噜噜的声音。
不过眨眼的功夫，迈巴鹤稳稳停在太和峰的一处平台，云洛被眼前这座灵玉雕刻而成的巨大宫殿所震撼。
她跳下鹤背，迎面款款走来一身着青衣的窈窕女子，眉心有一红色梅花印记。
合欢宗的颜值都超高，简直是颜狗福音。
“可是云洛师妹？”
云洛拱手行礼。
“正是，敢问师姐如何称呼？”
女子浅笑∶“我叫霍梅，是宗主的亲传弟子。”
“霍师姐。”
二人互相见礼一番，霍梅将她带去主殿。
“师妹直接进去便是。这是我的小小心意，当做是见面礼了，师妹莫要嫌弃。我还需修炼，便先走了，以后有空，多来太和峰玩儿。”
霍梅给了她一个乾坤袋，离开前，看她的目光风情万种、媚眼如丝。
不知是不是对方用了魅术，云洛感觉心跳加快，脸色也迅速涨红。
content_en:
Chapter 7: Rebuilding Spiritual Roots The five-day internship ended in the blink of an eye.
Yunluo lay on his back on the thick branch of the Albizia Julibrissin tree, holding a piece of Albizia Julibrissin cake in his mouth.
He lay on her belly, holding a spiritual grass in his two paws and chewing it like a rabbit. Finally, he took out a spiritual elixir from the brocade bag on Yunluo's waist and stuffed it into his mouth.
The spiritual herbs and elixirs were sent by senior sisters from other peaks.
The Hehuan Sect had not had a direct disciple for more than ten years, so Yunluo naturally became the younger junior sister in the direct line.
It is said that the people love Yao'er, which is not surprising in the world of immortality.
Yunluo accidentally became the group favorite.
Seeing that LaLa's cheeks were bulging from eating, she stroked its chubby head.
"Laila, do you like Hehuan Sect?"
Pulling the pill and nodding.
Its leg injury has healed, how can you not like it?
Yun Luo turned over and lay on his side: "I like it too. When my spiritual roots recover, I will find a better elixir for you and let you follow me to cultivate immortality."
According to the rabbit's lifespan, Tuolao's life must have come to an end, but thanks to the spiritual grass he has been feeding for many years, his current lifespan is at least thirty years.
This is called a person attaining enlightenment and a rabbit ascending to heaven.
After tugging at the pill, he rubbed his fat head against her cheek, then fell to the ground and turned over to reveal his soft belly.
Yunluo stretched out his evil hand and rubbed it twice.
This feels so cool.
After a moment of fighting, the jade slip shook. Yun Luo picked it up and saw that it was Elder Jinghong who asked her to quickly go to the main hall of Taihe Peak.
She didn't dare to delay and quickly blew the bone whistle hanging around her neck.
The Maiba Crane spread its huge wings and squatted under the tree.
Yunluo turned over and jumped up steadily, waving to the man on the tree.
"Wait for me at home."
He rolled his round body, yawned, and lay on the tree trunk making a purring sound.
But in the blink of an eye, Maiba Crane stopped steadily on a platform on Taihe Peak. Yunluo was shocked by the huge palace carved from spiritual jade in front of him.
She jumped off the crane's back, and a slim woman in green clothes walked towards her, with a red plum blossom mark between her eyebrows.
He Huanzong's looks are all very good, which is simply a blessing for good looks.
"But Junior Sister Yunluo?"
Yunluo bowed his hands.
"Exactly. May I ask what you call me, Senior Sister?"
The woman smiled slightly: "My name is Huo Mei, and I am the direct disciple of the sect master."
"Senior Sister Huo."
The two greeted each other, and Huo Mei took her to the main hall.
"Junior sister, just go in directly. This is my little thought, treat it as a greeting gift, please don't dislike it, junior sister. I still need to practice, so I will leave first. When I have time in the future, I will come to Taihe Peak more often."
Huo Mei gave her a Qiankun bag, and before leaving, he looked at her with a charming and charming look.
I don't know if the other party used charm skills, but Yun Luo felt his heart beat faster and his face turned red quickly.
